# Section 11: Library and Learning/Information Resources

Section 11 addresses library resources, services, and staffing.

## Standard 11.1 — Library and Learning/Information Resources [CR] {.core-requirement}

::: {.callout-important}
## Core Requirement
:::

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

The institution provides library and learning resources adequate for its programs and services.

### Typical Evidence Types

- Collection statistics (print, electronic, databases)
- Library hours and access information
- Resource acquisition process
- Faculty input into collection development
- Resource usage data

### Suggested Owners

- Library Director
- Chief Academic Officer

### Common Pitfalls / Weak Evidence

- Resources don't match program needs
- Limited access hours for student populations
- No faculty involvement in collection development
- Outdated or insufficient electronic resources

::: {.callout-note title="NC Considerations"}
NC community colleges have access to resources through the NC Community College Library Services (CCLINC consortium) and NC LIVE. Document:

- CCLINC membership benefits
- NC LIVE database access
- Consortium resource sharing
:::

---

## Standard 11.2 — Library/Information Staff

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

Staff administering library/information services are qualified.

### Typical Evidence Types

- Staff roster with credentials
- Position descriptions
- Professional development participation

### Common Pitfalls / Weak Evidence

- Insufficient staffing for services offered
- Staff credentials not documented
- Limited professional development

---

## Standard 11.3 — Library/Information Access

### What SACSCOC is Trying to Ensure

The institution provides access to resources and services that support instruction and learning regardless of location.

### Typical Evidence Types

- Remote access documentation
- Services for distance learners
- Hours of operation
- Information literacy instruction
- Interlibrary loan services

### Suggested Owners

- Library Director
- Distance Education Coordinator

### Common Pitfalls / Weak Evidence

- Distance students have limited access
- No information literacy program
- Limited hours for working students

---

## Reflective Prompts

- How do library resources align with program needs?
- What evidence shows effective information literacy instruction?
- How are off-campus and online student needs met?
